input.summary:
Clerk's office furnished in parts/room-5.mjs, drawn as three layers (floor, top, high) with layers(): a desk with a bottom-slab top on fence posts and a chair facing the door, filing bookshelves on the north and east walls, barrel drawers on the west wall, a red carpet rug and a lectern at the south end.
Light: a lit candle and a lantern on the desk, a lantern on a barrel, a lantern on the east shelf, and one on a post at the south-east corner. The room check says OK (70 of 71 cells walkable, min light 8, 0 dark, 0 dim). make.sh runs whole and the room render reads as an office.
The door is at x10 z16, where shell.mjs opens it, not z20 as plan.md says; I designed for z16.

waste.what: Reconciling plan.md's door position (x10 z20) with the door the shell actually cut (x10 z16): I had to grep shell.mjs to find it.
waste.cost: 1 grep plus a re-read of the plan grid; the plan's door text was wrong and nothing flagged it.
waste.tool: mcd plan should print the real openings and warn where rooms.json or plan.md disagree with the built shell.

waste.what: Choosing block states by hand (slab type, stairs facing for a chair, candles/lit, lantern hanging, lectern has_book) and guessing which helper ids exist.
waste.cost: About 10 state guesses, no rebuilds needed, but no reference used.
waste.tool: A furniture vocabulary with presets (deskSet, chairAt(facing), barrelRow, shelfWall) plus `mcd states` output inline in the plan would have cut this to one call.

waste.what: Light: the room check's LAMPS suggestion (a floor lantern at 5,4,14) needs a base block, so I worked out a lantern on a bookshelf top by hand, then rebuilt once.
waste.cost: One extra make.sh + room check cycle.
waste.tool: mcd room LAMPS should list standing spots on top of existing furniture (shelf tops, desk tops, barrel tops), not only bare floor cells.

waste.what: The walk verdict reports 70 of 71 reachable with the unreached cell 9,6,24, which is the top of the lamp lantern on the fence post, not a floor cell.
waste.cost: A dig into the output to confirm it was an artifact; I left it in place.
waste.tool: mcd room should not count the top of a standing lantern or a post as standable floor.

companions.task: Check the light map once the chimney's fireplace campfire is in the merged build, and decide whether the east-shelf lantern and the post lamp are still needed.
Set the clerk's chair stair facing and half so it reads as a seat facing the desk, and confirm the chair cell is reachable from the lane at z14..15.
Fill the barrel drawers on the west wall with the right contents and check that the barrel facing (open top) reads as filing storage.

left: The door is at x10 z16 (shell.mjs opens it there), not x10 z20 as plan.md and rooms.json say. Fix the plan's Notes or the shell; I did not edit plan.md because other workers share it.
The walk verdict says 70 of 71 floor cells reachable: 9,6,24 is the top of the lamp lantern on the post at x9 z24, counted as standable. The verdict is still OK; move the post if it matters.
The light map is measured without the chimney's lit fireplace (the chimney part builds it before this room); the room is lit at min 8 without it, so this is a bonus, not a dependency.
plan.md's checklist has no room rows, so nothing was ticked there; elements.md item 23 (interior) is partly built, the Clerk's office only.
Structure check shows nothing wrong in my blocks; its unsupported ladder at x21 z27..31 and orphan bricks at z26 belong to the shell, not this part.
